newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia farmers welcome WTO trade talks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia farmers welcome WTO trade talks.

text.p: Australia's National Farmers' Federation (NFF) on Friday welcomed Thursday's agreement by the 130 countries of the World Trade Organisation (WTO) to begin a new round of talks aimed at continuing the freeing up of world agricultural trade.
The agreement would provide a good basis for a new round of talks in 1999, NFF senior vice president John Watson said in a statement.

NFF president Donald McGauchie had been invited to the WTO's December meeting in Singapore where a new process on issues such as continuing high tariffs on agricultural imports imposed by some countries, as well as non-tariff trade barriers, would be initiated, the NFF said.
Australia is a strong proponent of free farm trade.
